relationships.subject: PRMT7
relationships.evidence_quote: PRMT7 mainly binds to residues 563 to 566 within the first intracellular loop of hNaV1.9 (hLoop1) and methylates hLoop1 at arginine residue 519

relationships.subject: PRMT7
relationships.evidence_quote: coelectroporation of human SCN11A and PRMT7 in dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons of Scn11a-/- mice increased the hNaV1.9 current density

relationships.subject: DS-437
relationships.evidence_quote: a PRMT7 inhibitor (DS-437) reduced mNaV1.9 currents in Scn11a+/+ mice

relationships.subject: PRMT7
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of PRMT7 increased the number of action potential fired in DRG neurons of Scn11a+/+ mice but not Scn11a-/- mice

relationships.subject: DS-437
relationships.evidence_quote: DS-437 significantly inhibited the action potential frequency of DRG neurons and relieved pain hypersensitivity in Scn11aA796G/A796G mice

key_findings: PRMT7 binds NaV1.9 loop1 (residues 563-566) and methylates R519, increasing NaV1.9 surface expression and current density.
PRMT7 inhibitor DS-437 reduced DRG excitability and pain hypersensitivity in NaV1.9 gain-of-function mice.
